title: Java Project Management REST API
description: A robust REST API designed for project lifecycle management. This application implements full CRUD operations with Spring Data JPA, utilizing a layered architecture (Controller, Repository, Entity) and automated unit testing to ensure data integrity.
tech: Java, Spring Boot, H2 Database, Maven, etc

title: Patent Data API & Graph Modeling
description: Research project focused on large-scale patent data extraction, graph modeling, and interactive data exploration. The project integrates the PatentsView API using Node.js and stores structured patent relationships in Neo4J for advanced querying and visualization.
tech: Node.js, REST API, Neo4J, Selenium, Scrum

title: Personal Portfolio Full Stack API
tech: CI/CD, Docker, Python, REST API, etc
description: Full-stack portfolio built with a decoupled architecture using FastAPI and Vanilla JavaScript. Features RESTful API integration, multi-language support (EN/PT), dynamic JSON-based content management, and a resilient fallback strategy to ensure availability. Includes containerization and CI/CD pipeline for automated deployment.

title: Simulation to Teach Physics
description: This project demonstrates how Python can be used to simulate drag force in free fall motion. It was originally developed as part of a teaching experiment to help high school students understand real-world physics beyond simplified textbook problems

title: Z-score (Statistical Test)
description: Statistics is a crucial tool for science, business, and economics. This project makes a statistical test 15x faster than humans and much more secure from mistakes.

title: Condensed Matter (Physics)
description: This project returns the crystal system based on your data about the axes and angles.
